title: 30 MINUTES FEARLESS WARFARE MORNING PRAYERS
text: Oh, we worship you this morning. We worship you, lion of the tribe of Judah. We worship you, the man of war. We worship you, the Lord, strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in battle. We give you glory. We give you honor. We give you praise. There is none like you. There is none beside you. In all the earth, there is none that compares to you. Baruk Hashem Adonai. Baruk Hashem Adonai. Father, we thank you. We thank you for breath. We thank you for life. We thank you for another morning that we did not earn. We thank you for mercy that is new. We thank you for grace that is sufficient. We thank you Lord that while others did not wake up, you preserved us. While others closed their eyes and never opened them again, you kept us. And so we do not take this moment for granted. We give you praise. We give you all the glory. Somebody, wherever you are right now, I want you to just open your mouth and begin to worship him. Don't be casual. Don't be cold. Don't let this just be another morning. Something is about to shift. Something is about to break. The atmosphere is already pregnant with the power of God. And if you can connect, if you can plug in by faith, if you can open your spirit, what God is about to do in the next few minutes will mark your life forever. Raboni. Raonai, we worship you. We give you glory, Jesus. We give you praise. Now listen, before we go deep into this morning's warfare, I want you to do something. Share this. Send it to someone right now. There is somebody in your contact list. There is somebody on your timeline. There is somebody who has been going through a battle they have not told anyone about. And God in his sovereignty wants to use you as the bridge between their pain and their breakthrough. Don't hoard this. Don't keep it to yourself. Be an instrument. Be a vessel. Let the word of the Lord reach somebody through your hand this morning. Do it now. Share it. Send the link. Post it. You do not know whose deliverance is tied to your obedience in this moment. Now, settling. Settling. What we are about to engage in is not casual. This is not entertainment. This is not background noise for your morning routine. What we're about to do is warfare. Real spiritual violent kingdom warfare. And I need your focus. I need your faith. I need your fire. Let me establish something from scripture. Open your Bible with me. 2 Corinthians chapter 10:es 3-5. Paul writes, and I want you to hear this carefully. For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh. For the weapons of our warfare are not cannal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strongholds, casting down imaginations and every high thing that exaltth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ. Now look at that again. Paul did not say we do not have warfare. He said the weapons of our warfare are not carnal. This means that warfare is real. Conflict in the spirit realm is real. [music] Opposition is real. But the weapons God has given us are not natural weapons. They are not weapons made of steel or gunpowder. They are weapons forged in the fires of heaven. They are weapons that carry the authority of the throne of God. They are weapons that demons tremble at. They are weapons that break iron gates and shatter bronze bars. And then look at Ephesians chapter 6:12. For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places. Now hear me. Hear me well. The reason many believers are losing battles they should be winning is not because God has abandoned them. It is not because the blood of Jesus has lost its power. It is because they have refused to fight. They have become passive. They have become comfortable. They have been lulled into a spiritual slumber by the enemy. And while they were sleeping, the adversary has been busy. While they were relaxed, altars were being erected. While they were distracted by the cares of this world, covenants were being reinforced. And this morning, the spirit of the living God is saying, "Wake up. Rise up. Stand up. It is time to fight. Listen carefully. There are dimensions to spiritual warfare that the average believer does not understand. There is a level of combat in the spirit that requires more than singing a worship song once a week. There is a level of engagement that demands that you rise before the suns and take your position at the altar of prayer. There is a dimension of authority that only comes through consistent, violent, aggressive, faithfilled intercession. Jesus said it in Matthew 11:12. And from [music] the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven suffered violence, and the violent take it by force. This is not a suggestion. This is a kingdom principle. [music] The violent take it by force. Not the lazy, not the passive, not the ones who hope things will work out on their own. The violent, [music] the ones who understand that there is a fight and who are willing to engage. Now, why did I title this fearless warfare? Because one of the greatest weapons the enemy uses against believers is fear. Fear of the unknown, fear of failure, fear of the enemy's power, fear that the battle is too great, fear that the opposition is too strong. And I have come to tell you this morning by the authority of the word of God. God has not given you the spirit of fear. 2 Timothy 1:7, for God hath not given us the spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind. The fear you have been feeling is not from God. The anxiety that grips you when you think about the future is not from God. The terror that comes upon you in the night season, when your mind begins to race with worst case scenarios, that is not from God. That is a spirit. And spirits can be cast out. Spirits can be rebuked. Spirits can be silenced by the name that is above every name. I decree over your life this morning, the spirit of fear is broken. The spirit of intimidation is broken. The spirit of timidity that has kept you from praying bold prayers and making bold declarations, it is broken right now in the name of Jesus. You see, the enemy does not want you praying this morning. The enemy did not want you tuning in. The enemy fought to keep you asleep. The enemy sent heaviness to your eyes. He sent distraction to your mind. He whispered, "You can pray later. You can listen to this some other time, but you are here. And because you are here, something is about to happen. Because you showed up to the battle, the tide is about to turn." Isaiah 54:17, "No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper, and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn." This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is of me, says the Lord. But I want you to notice something. It says, "No weapon formed against you shall prosper." It does not say, "No weapon shall be formed. Weapons will be formed. Attacks will be launched. Arrows will be fired." But the promise is that none of them, not one, not a single one shall prosper. They will not succeed. They will not achieve their purpose. They will not land. They will fall to the ground. They will return to the sender. Why? Because the Lord himself is your defense. Because the blood of Jesus is your covering. Because the angels of the most high are encamped around you. Psalm 34:7. The angel of the Lord encampeth round about them that fear him and deliverth them. You are not alone in this fight. You have never been alone. The mountain is full of horses and chariots of fire. 2 Kings 6:1 17 Elisha prayed, "Lord, open his eyes that he may see. And when the young man's eyes were opened, he saw the hills full of horses and chariots of fire all around Elisha. The angels of God are assigned to your life. The hosts of heaven are backing you up. The heavenly army is on your side. And when God is for you, tell me who can be against you. Romans chapter 8:31. If God be for us, who can be against us? No one. Nothing. No demon, no principality, no power, no throne, no dominion, no witch, no wizard, no covenant, no altar, no curse, no covenant. Nothing in all of creation can stand against you when the God of heaven is fighting your battles. Now I want to shift. I want to begin to pray. And I want you to pray with everything in you. Don't be a spectator. Be a participant. Open your mouth. Let the words of warfare flow from your lips like fire. Let your declaration shake the foundations of every demonic stronghold that has been erected against your life, your family, your destiny, your marriage, your finances, your health, your ministry, your calling. Are you ready? Let us pray. Father, in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, I come before your throne this morning. I come not by my own righteousness, but by the blood of the lamb. I come not by my own strength but by the power of the Holy Spirit. I come not by my own authority but by the authority that has been given to me through Christ Jesus. And I stand in the gap. I stand in the gap for every soul under the sound of my voice. I stand in the gap for every life that is connected to this prayer. And I decree, I declare that the heavens are open over this moment. The heavens are open over this prayer and every word spoken in faith will land with power in the spirit realm. Now lift your voice. Lift your voice and pray with me. Every altar that has been erected against my destiny, I command fire. Every altar in my father's house that is speaking against my progress, catch fire right now in the name of Jesus. Every altar in my mother's lineage that has been programmed to delay, to frustrate, to hinder, to block, I decree that altar is dismantled by the blood of Jesus. Every priest ministering at those altars, every voice crying out against me from dark places, every incantation, every invocation, every ritual, I silence you by the authority of heaven. The Bible says in Numbers 23 23, "Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel." And I stand on that word this morning. There is no enchantment that can walk against me. There is no divination that can succeed against my household. There is no sorcery that can penetrate the hedge of fire that God has placed around my life. I speak to every monitoring spirit, every eye that has been assigned to watch my movements, to track my progress, to report my blessings to the kingdom of darkness. I blind you right now in the name of Jesus. I release the fire of the Holy Ghost against every monitoring agent. [music] I release confusion into every coven where my name is being mentioned. I decree that every gathering of the wicked against my life is scattered like smoke before the wind, like wax before the fire. Psalm 68:es 1 and 2. Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered. Let them also that hate him flee before him. [music] As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melted before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God. Let God arise over my life this morning. Let God arise over my family. Let God arise over my marriage. Let God arise over my finances. Let God arise over my health. Let God arise over my calling. Let God arise over my ministry. And let every enemy be scattered. I decree [music] and declare every chain is broken, every yoke is destroyed. Isaiah 10:27. And it shall come to pass in that day that his burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing. The anointing is here this morning. The anointing is present, and the anointing destroys every yoke. The yoke of poverty destroyed. The yoke of sickness destroyed. The yoke of barness destroyed. The yoke of delay destroyed. The yoke of stagnation destroyed. The yoke of marital failure destroyed. The yoke of generational repetition destroyed. The yoke of premature death destroyed. The yoke of mental oppression destroyed. I hear the spirit of God saying something. Listen, someone under the sound of my voice, the Lord is showing me. You have been carrying a burden that was never yours to carry. You inherited a fight from your father's house. You inherited a battle from a generation before you. And you have been struggling with something that didn't originate with you. But the Lord says this morning, I am breaking the cycle. I am ending the pattern. What plagued your father will not plague you. What destroyed your mother's joy will not touch yours. I am doing a new thing. Isaiah 43:E 19. Behold, I will do a new thing. Now it shall spring forth. Shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness and rivers in the desert. [music] God is making a way for you right now. In the wilderness of your confusion, he's making a way. In the desert of your lack, he's creating rivers. In the barrenness of your waiting, he's planting seeds of breakthrough. Now, I want to pray specifically. Let us deal with the area of destiny. Father, I pray for every destiny under the sound of my voice. I pray for every calling, every assignment, every purpose. Lord, you said in Jeremiah 1:5, "Before I formed thee in the belly, I knew thee. [music] And before thou camest forth out of the womb, I sanctified thee. And I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations. You knew us before we were formed, you had a plan before we took our first breath. And I decree this morning that no devil in hell, no agent of darkness, no human instrument of wickedness will succeed in aborting the purpose of God for the lives of your children. Every arrow of destiny assassination, I command those arrows to return to the sender sevenfold. Every plot to steal destiny exposed and destroyed. Every spiritual thief that has been stealing time, stealing opportunities, stealing connection, stealing resources, I bind you. I strip you of your power. I command you to release everything you have stolen. Proverbs 6:31. But if he be found, he must restore sevenfold. He shall give all the substance of his house. Sevenfold restoration. That is what I'm decreeing over your life this morning. Everything the enemy has stolen, your time, your youth, your opportunities, your relationships, your money, your health. Sevenfold restoration is coming to you. Joel 2:2. And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten the canker worm and the caterpillar and the palmer worm. My great army which I sent among you. The years have been restored. The wasted seasons have been redeemed. God is compressing time on your behalf. What should have taken you 10 years, God will do in one. What should have taken you 5 years, God will accomplish in 6 months. There is an acceleration upon your life. There is a divine fastforward button being pressed over your destiny. I decree acceleration. I decree speed. I decree momentum. I decree that the hand of the Lord is upon you for swiftness like Elijah outran the chariot of Ahab. You will outrun every limitation. First Kings chapter 18 verse 46. And the hand of the Lord was on Elijah, and he gathered up his loins and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezrael. The hand of the Lord is upon you this morning. The hand of the Lord is upon your career. The hand of the Lord is upon your business. The hand of the Lord is upon your academics. The hand of the Lord is upon your ministry. And because his hand is upon you, you will run and not be weary. You will walk and not faint. Isaiah 40:31. Now I shift to the area of family deliverance. Every cause operating in family lines I break it now. Every pattern of failure, every pattern of divorce, every pattern of untimely death, every pattern of poverty, every pattern of madness, every pattern of addiction, I sever the cord. I cut the chain. I break the link. By the blood of Jesus, I disconnect every life under the sound of my voice from every ancestral pattern of defeat. Galatians chapter 3:13, Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law being made a cost for us. For it is written, cost is everyone that hangeth on a tree. You have been redeemed. The price has been paid. The blood has been shed. And there is no cost that has legal right over your life anymore. Any cause still operating is operating illegally. And this morning we serve it an eviction notice in the name of Jesus. Every cause of you will never succeed. [music] Every cause of you will end up like your father. Every cause of no one in your family ever makes it. Every course spoken by envious relatives, by bitter neighbors, by jealous friends. I break it. I nullify it. I cancel it. The word of God says in Proverbs chapter 26:2, "As the bird by wandering, as the swallow by flying, so the causeless shall not come. And because you are covered by the blood, there is no cause for any cause to remain." So I command every lingering cause, depart. depart from their finances, depart from their bodies, depart from their marriages, depart from their children, depart from their minds in the mighty mighty name of Jesus. Someone, the Lord is speaking to me. There is a woman and I don't know where you are, but the spirit of God is very clear. You have been believing God for the fruit of the womb. And every month has been a disappointment. Every test has come back the same. And you have cried tears that nobody has seen. You have asked questions in the night that nobody has heard. But the Lord says to you this morning, Sarah laughed, but she still carried Isaac. Hannah wept, but she still brought forth Samuel. Elizabeth was called barren, but she still bore John. And the Lord says to you, "Your season of baroness is over. I am opening your womb. I am commanding conception. I am releasing the blessing of fruitfulness upon your body." Psalm 127:3, "Lo, children and heritage of the Lord, and the fruit of the womb is his reward." Receive it. Receive it by faith. It is done. It is done. Now, I move to the area of finances. Father, I pray against every spirit of poverty. I pray against every financial embgo. I pray against every invisible hand that has been blocking resources from reaching your children. Lord, you said in Deuteronomy chapter 8:18, "But thou shalt remember the Lord thy God. For it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant, which is swear unto thy fathers, as it is this day. It is God who gives the power to get wealth." [music] And I decree this morning that the power to create wealth is being released upon every life under the sound of my voice. Every blocked financial gate open now. Every hand of the Egyptians holding back your resources be paralyzed now. Every spiritual padlock placed upon your financial doors, I break it by fire. I prophesy new streams of income are opening. Unexpected doors of provision are swinging wide. Contracts that were held up are being released. Deals that were stalled are being revived. Debts that have been crushing you are being supernaturally cancelled. Philippians 4:1 19. But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus. Not according to the economy, not according to the exchange rate, not according to the job market, according to his riches in glory. And his riches have no limit. His supply has no end. His resources have no boundary. Michael, I hear the name Michael in my spirit. The Lord says that financial drought is ending today. Something is breaking loose over your finances this week. A door you did not knock on is about to open. A provision you did not apply for is about to arrive. The Lord says, "I am Jehovah Gyre, and I have not forgotten you." Now, health and healing by the stripes of Jesus Christ, I speak healing into every sick body under the sound of my voice. 1 Peter 2:4, "Who his own self bear our sins in his own body on the tree, that we being dead to sins should live unto righteousness, by whose stripes ye were healed." Notice the tense were healed, past tense, it is already done. The healing has already been accomplished at Calvary. What you are contending for is the manifestation of what has already been settled in heaven. Every tumor I c you at the root, dry up and die in the name of Jesus. Every cancerous cell I command you to bow to the name of Jesus. Every autoimmune attack against the bodies of God's children seize. I speak to blood. I speak to bones. I speak to organs. I speak to tissues. I speak to cells. I speak to DNA. Be healed. Be restored. Be made whole. Exodus 15 26. I am the Lord that health thee. He is Jehovah Rafa, the God who heals. Not the God who might heal, not the God who heals sometimes. The God who heals. Period. Full stop. I [music] destroy every spirit of infirmity. Every spirit that has attached itself to bodies to bring chronic pain, to bring recurring illness, to bring mysterious symptoms that doctors cannot diagnose. I rebuke you. I cast you out. You have no legal right. The blood of Jesus has revoked your access. Leave now and never return. Someone, you have been having pain in the left side of your body. The doctors have run tests and found nothing, but the pain persists. The Lord is revealing to me that it is a spiritual attack and it is ending right now. Place your hand where the pain is and receive your healing in the name of Jesus. I command that pain to leave. Go. Go now. Never return. Be healed in Jesus name. Shondola rabo. Now marriage and relationships. Father, I speak to every delayed marriage. I speak to every troubled union. I speak to every home that is on the verge of collapse. Lord, what you have joined together, let no man put us under. Mark 10:9. And I decree that no devil, no third party, no in-law, no strange woman, no strange man, no spirit of divorce will succeed in destroying what God has built. Every spirit of Jezebel operating in marriages, I bind you. Every spirit of Ahab operating in marriages, I bind you. Every spirit of lust, of adultery, of fornication, of pornography that is eaten away at the foundations of godly homes, I rebuke you. I cast you out. I command you to release your grip. For those waiting for a spouse, I prophesy your Boaz is coming. [music] Your Ruth is coming. Your Isaac is coming. Your Rebecca is coming. The Lord is orchestrating a divine connection. Not a mistake, not a [music] near miss. A divine heavens sent purpose aligned connection. And it is closer than you think. There is someone your name begins with the letter S. You almost gave up on marriage. You almost accepted that it wasn't God's will for you. But the Lord says I created marriage. It was my idea and what I have purposed for you. No delay can cancel. Get ready. Prepare your heart. Your season of companionship is at the door. Now I want to go deeper into warfare. I want to deal with witchcraft. every witchcraft operation against the lives of God's children. I decree confusion into your camp. I scatter every gathering of witches and warlocks that has convened against destinies connected to this prayer. Acts 13 10 and 11. Paul looked at Elmas the sorcerer and said, "Oh fool of all subility and all mischief, thou child of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness. Wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?" And now, behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. I release the hand of the Lord against every sorcerer, every diver, every enchanter, every necromancer, every medium that has been hired or assigned against your life. I decree blindness upon them. I decree confusion upon them. I decree that every evil port is broken, every cauldron is overturned, every mirror used for remote viewing against your life is shattered by the fire of the Holy Ghost. Micah 5:12, "And I will cut off witchcrafts out of thine hand, and thou shalt have no more soothsayers." The Lord himself is cutting off the witchcraft. The Lord himself is dealing with the source. You don't have to fight this battle alone. The captain of the host of the Lord is standing with his sword drawn and he's saying, "I will fight for you." Exodus 14:14, "The Lord shall fight for you and ye shall hold your peace. Every charm, every amulet, every talisman, every fetish that has been prepared with your name, your picture, your clothing, your hair, I release fire. Holy Ghost fire, consuming fire. The kind of fire that fell on Mount Camel, the kind of fire that consumed the sacrifice, the stones, the water and the dust, that fire is falling right now upon every witchcraft artifact connected to your life. Burn, burn, burn in the name of Jesus. I come against every evil dream. Every dream where you eat in the dream. Every dream where you see yourself in your old village. Every dream where dead relatives appear to you. Every dream where you are swimming in dirty water. Every dream where you are being chased. Every dream where you find yourself in a wedding with an unknown person. I cancel those dreams. I nullify their effects. I decree that no dream initiated by the kingdom of darkness will manifest in your waking life. I plead the blood of Jesus over your dream life. I assign warrior angels to guard your subconscious. No more manipulations. No more spiritual transactions while you sleep. It is over. Now let me deal with the area of time and virtue restoration. There is a concept that many believers don't understand. The enemy doesn't just steal money. He doesn't just steal health. He steals time. He steals virtues. He steals grace. He steals glory. And there are people under the sound of my voice whose glory has been exchanged. Whose star has been caged, whose light has been deemed by demonic activity. But hear what the word says. Zechariah 9:12. turn you to the stronghold, ye prisoners of hope. Even today do I declare that I will render double unto thee. Double. God is not just restoring. He is doubling. He is not just bringing you back to where you were. He's taking you beyond. What was stolen in 10 years, God is restoring in one. The glory that was taken is being returned with interest. The light that was deemed is [clears throat] being reignited with greater intensity. I command every cage holding your starreak. I command every pot where your glory has been buried shatter. I command every river where your virtue was deposited. Release it now. I speak to the north, the south, the east, [music] the west. Give back what belongs to the children of God. Isaiah 43:5 and 6. Fear not, for I am with thee. I will bring thy seed from the east and gather thee from the west. I will say to the north, give up. And to the south, keep not back. Give up. Keep not back. Release what you have stolen. Return what you have withheld in the mighty name of Jesus. Every year that the locust consumed, restored. Every opportunity that the cankerworm destroyed, replaced with something greater. Every relationship that the palmer worm killed, God is raising up new anointed destiny aligned connections. I hear the spirit of God saying the next 90 days of your life will carry more testimony than the last 5 years combined. There is a compression of blessing. There is an acceleration of favor. There is a convergence of divine moments. Doors that should have opened one at a time will open simultaneously. Blessings that should have come in sequence will come in clusters. Get ready. Get your faith ready. Get your mouth ready to testify. Now, divine preservation. Psalm 91, I want you to hear this. Verses 1-7. He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most high shall abide under the shadow of the almighty. I will say of the Lord, he is my refuge and my fortress, my God. In him will I trust. Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler and from the noisome pestilence. He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust. His truth shall be thy shield and buckler. Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, nor for the arrow that flyth by day, nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness, nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday. A thousand shall fall at thy side, and 10,000 at thy right hand, but it shall not come nigh thee. I [music] decree divine preservation over every life connected to this prayer. No accident will [music] claim you. No plague will touch you. No bullet will find you. No disaster will consume you. No terrorist will reach you. No pandemic will overwhelm you. You are hidden in Christ. You are sealed by the spirit. You are covered by the blood. You are surrounded by angels. Every trap that has been set on the road you would travel today, I dismantle it by fire. Every ambush that has been planned for your commute, for your journey, for your travels, I scatter it in the name of Jesus. I speak to every vehicle you will enter, you are sanctified. I speak to every building you will walk into, you are covered. I speak to every meal you will eat, it is blessed. No poison, no contamination, no harm. Cay masho raba cay shandola kay raba mash sandola the spirit of God is speaking listen carefully there is a young man you are in your 20ies you have been contemplating giving up not just giving up on a project or a plan but giving up on life itself has been so thick the loneliness has been so heavy but the Lord says I have plans for you Jeremiah 29:1 plans to prosper you and not to harm you. Plans to give you a hope and a future. Do not let the enemy write the ending of your story. God is the author and the finisher. And the chapter you are in right now is not the final chapter. Joy is coming. Purpose is coming. Connection is coming. Hold on. The morning is breaking. There is someone else. You are dealing with a legal situation. A case that has been hanging over your head. court proceedings that have been draining you emotionally and financially. But the Lord says, "I am the judge of all the earth." Genesis 18:2, "And I am ruling in your favor. The verdict will shift. The case will turn. The result will surprise your adversaries." The Lord says, "Be at peace. I am handling it." And there is someone you live abroad and you have been sending money home, but it seems like nothing ever changes. The family keeps calling with crisis after crisis and you are exhausted. But the Lord says, I am breaking the pattern. I am breaking the cycle of perpetual lack in your family. A root issue is being dealt with in the spirit this morning. Something is shifting at the foundation. And from this day forward, your labor will not be in vain. Your seeds will produce harvest. Your sacrifice will be honored. Now, I want to seal this. I want to bring this to a prophetic close. Raise your hands wherever you are. Raise them high. This is the posture of surrender. This is the posture of reception. This is the posture that says, "Lord, I receive everything you have spoken. Father, in the name of Jesus, I seal every word that has been spoken this morning. Every declaration, every decree, every prophetic utterance, every prayer, I seal it with the blood of the lamb. I seal it with the fire of the Holy Ghost. I seal it with the authority of heaven. I decree the siege is over. Whatever has been besieging your life, the siege is over. Whatever has been encamping against you, the camp is broken. Whatever has held you hostage, the chains are shattered. Walk into favor. Walk into open doors. Walk into divine connections. Walk into financial overflow. Walk into physical health. Walk into mental clarity. Walk into emotional stability. Walk into spiritual depth. Walk into everything God has prepared for you before the foundation of the world. Your destiny is preserved. No one can take what God has assigned to you. Your portion is secured. Your inheritance is intact. Your calling is irrevocable. Romans 11:29. For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance. God has not changed his mind about you. He has not altered his plan. He has not revised his purpose. You are still the one he chose. You are still the one he called. You are still the one he anointed. And what he started, he will finish. Philippians 1:6. being confident of this very thing that he which had begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ. I decree this morning is your turning point. I [music] decree this day is the beginning of a new season. I decree that from this moment things will never be the same. The old season is dead. The new season is alive. Behold all things have become new. Mashola. Every demon that was assigned against you this week, I bind you. I render you powerless. You will not succeed. You will not prevail. You will not execute your mission. The blood of Jesus is against you. The fire of the Holy Ghost is against you. The angels of the most high are against you. Flee. Flee. flee in the name of Jesus. I release angelic reinforcement over your life. I release waring angels. I release ministering angels. I release angels of provision. I release angels of protection. I release angels of acceleration. Hebrews 1:14. Are they not all ministering spirits sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation? You are an heir of salvation. And the angels have been sent to minister for you. They are on assignment. They are active. They are fighting battles you cannot see. They are opening doors you cannot reach. They are moving people you cannot influence. Trust the process. Trust the Lord of the process. This is your week. I declare it. I decree it. I seal it. This is your week of breakthrough. This is your week of miracles. This is your week of answers.
